arc: Ledger full-voice: SILENCE (Preface, system off) → FULL INSTRUMENT (Ch I inquisition, brass numerals as scanning anchors) → [deferred: gate-breathing II, ember III] → MAXIM-SET (Ch IV centerpiece, discrete blocks, hanging numerals, hairlines every ~5, §146 sanguine) → handoff to BACK lowland.
art_direction: books/beyond-good-and-evil/design/ART-DIRECTION.md (Direction A 'The Numbered Ledger', ArtDirector APPROVED with binding conditions E1–E7)

binding_conditions.E1: Margin numerals via DOM wrap ONLY (<span class='sec-num'> by supervisor's book-owned JS; regex ^(\d{1,3}[A-Z]?)\.(\s|--)); static nth-of-type content: numerals FORBIDDEN. §5.1 index is the TEST ORACLE (FRONT rows verified EXACT by lead).
binding_conditions.E2: Brass figures engraved, never glowing: flat, letterspaced, archival; zero halos/gradient fills.
binding_conditions.E3: Sanguine rationed: FRONT spends ONLY p1c4 §50 (deferred) and p1c5 §146 (abyss).
binding_conditions.E4: Silence total on p1c1: no figures, no seals, no numerals, Sanguine fleuron only; one stray § fails review.
binding_conditions.E5: Ch IV prototype must show full mid-chapter maxim screen proving density without cramp.

p1c1.content_rationale: Unnumbered Preface (6 paras, 0 section starts verified): 'SUPPOSING that Truth is a woman—what then?' (¶1), dogma 'at its last gasp' (¶2), the 'tensely strained bow' and 'THE GOAL TO AIM AT' (¶5), signed 'Sils Maria Upper Engadine, JUNE, 1885' (¶6). Per E4 the ledger system falls SILENT here: pure verse typography, no figures/seals/numerals — the lyric register made structural. The veil fleuron (salvaged from rejected Direction B) nods to Truth-as-woman who 'has never allowed herself to be won'.
p1c1.motif_asset: art/front-fleuron-veil.svg — single Sanguine veil-line fleuron in #chapter-art (E4: the ONLY mark). No seal, no figures.
p1c1.opener_composition: #chapter-art fleuron only → Plex Mono kicker 'PREFACE · SILS MARIA, JUNE 1886' → Fraunces title → double rule (2px brass over 1px faded) → Source Serif italic gloss (supervisor map). Verse-wide measure, centered. Single drop cap 'S' (only numbered-chapter caps are forbidden; p1c1 keeps its cap). Final dateline paragraph right-aligned italic colophon.
p1c1.palette_role: Silence register: Ledger Black ground, Vellum Smoke type, brass rule only, one Sanguine fleuron. No numerals anywhere (E4).
p1c1.reading_treatment: Calm 6-paragraph lyric read; generous measure; colophon styling on final dateline para. Chapter-end mark: none (unnumbered — no '§ last').
p1c1.title: Preface

p1c2.content_rationale: The demolition chapter, §§1–23 (75 paras, 23 starts, §5.1 row verified EXACT): Sphinx vs Oedipus 'rendezvous of questions and notes of interrogation' (§1); 'THE BELIEF IN ANTITHESES OF VALUES' (§2); Tartuffe-Kant's 'dialectic by-ways', Spinoza in 'mail and mask' (§5); the Table of Categories + 'virtus dormitiva' comedy (§11); 'pale, cold, grey conceptional networks' over 'the motley whirl of the senses' (§14); Munchausen self-hauling (§21); closing sea-voyage 'right OVER morality' crowning psychology 'queen of the sciences' (§23). The Sphinx-gap seal stages the inquisition: two profiles facing across a riddle-gap (black-figure lekythos composition per directions ref 12).
p1c2.motif_asset: art/front-seal-1-sphinx.svg — 1px brass intaglio seal (~120px): concentric rules + Sphinx-gap glyph (seated Sphinx profile confronting a standing questioner across a gap). Flat, no gradients. #chapter-art: seal + giant flat Fraunces range figures '1–23' (composition I: left-figures/right-seal).
p1c2.opener_composition: #chapter-art (figures + seal) → Plex Mono kicker 'CHAPTER I · §§1–23' → Fraunces title 'Prejudices of Philosophers' → double rule → italic gloss (supervisor map). NO drop cap (margin numeral is the entry).
p1c2.palette_role: Full-voice brass instrument: brass margin numerals (Plex Mono 500, 0.8rem) as scanning anchors down 7430 words; Faded Entry ruled lines; zero Sanguine in this chapter.
p1c2.reading_treatment: Long-essay relief: extra air above each section-start paragraph; margin numerals in 4.5rem left margin (desktop ≥900px), inline brass prefix + hanging indent below 900px; chapter-end mark '§ 23' in Plex Mono. Styles .sec-num + section-paragraph class identically for both wrapper trigger paths (reader:chapter / DOMContentLoaded+click fallback).
p1c2.title: Prejudices of Philosophers

p1c3.content_rationale: DEFERRED to post-prototype expansion (E7): gate-breathing chapter, §§24–44 (59 paras, 21 starts, §5.1 row verified EXACT). Masks ('Everything that is profound loves the mask', §40), tempo (presto/lento/staccato, §§27–28), labyrinth + 'minotaur of conscience' (§29), 'PURE air' (§30), 'sec, clair, sans illusion' (§39), the flier's 'voluptuous distance' (§41), 'midnight and midday solitude' (§44). Treatment (planned): open-gate seal, slightly wider measure, brass numerals.
p1c3.opener_composition: DEFERRED. Planned: centered stacked figures+seal per §5.3 composition II.
p1c3.palette_role: DEFERRED. Planned: brass numerals, airiest FRONT voice.
p1c3.reading_treatment: DEFERRED. Planned: free-breathing measure, brass numerals.
p1c3.title: The Free Spirit

p1c4.content_rationale: DEFERRED to post-prototype expansion (E7): ember chapter, §§45–62 (46 paras, 18 starts, §5.1 row verified EXACT). Virgin-forest 'big hunt' (§45), 'continuous suicide of reason' + 'God on the Cross' (§46), saint-worship wrecking psychology (§47), ladder of religious cruelty — firstlings → instincts → 'to sacrifice God himself… To sacrifice God for nothingness' (§55), 'circulus vitiosus deus' (§56), piety as 'the most elaborate and ultimate product of the FEAR of truth' (§59), 'some divine hammer' (§62). FRONT's single Sanguine intrusion before the summit: §50 numeral in blood (E3).
p1c4.opener_composition: DEFERRED. Planned: seal-above-figures per §5.3 composition III.
p1c4.palette_role: DEFERRED. Planned: FRONT's ember — §50 sanguine numeral (E3's only FRONT red besides §146).
p1c4.reading_treatment: DEFERRED. Planned: slowest leading, flame seal, sanguine §50.
p1c4.title: The Religious Mood

p1c5.content_rationale: COHORT CENTERPIECE. 125 maxims §§63–185 (129 paras, 125 starts, §5.1 row verified EXACT; continuations at paras 8/47/50/75): 'FETTERED HEART, FREE SPIRIT' (§87), ice that burns (§91), salted truth (§81), poisoned Eros (§168), Cyclops tenderness (§171) — and the sentence the book is remembered by: 'if thou gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will also gaze into thee' (§146, Sanguine per E3). Form IS content (La Rochefoucauld precedent, directions ref 8): each numbered unit a discrete block with air, number first, never run-on. Scattered-sorts seal: type sorts falling like hail (salvaged from rejected Direction C).
p1c5.motif_asset: art/front-seal-4-sorts.svg — 1px brass intaglio seal: concentric rules + scattered type-sorts glyph. #chapter-art: scattered small-figures field + seal (composition IV).
p1c5.opener_composition: #chapter-art (figures field + seal) → kicker 'CHAPTER IV · §§63–185' → Fraunces title → double rule → gloss. NO drop cap. Prototype MUST include a full mid-chapter maxim screen (E5).
p1c5.palette_role: Maxim-set mode: brass hanging numerals throughout; §146 the single Sanguine numeral (E3); hairlines every ~5 maxims (DOM-class or positional styling on wrapped sections — NEVER nth-of-type content: numerals).
p1c5.reading_treatment: Each section a discrete block (margin-bottom ~1.6em) with hanging numeral; hairline separators every ~5 maxims; density without cramp (E5: if it fatigues, add air before touching numerals); chapter-end mark '§ 185'.
p1c5.title: Apophthegms and Interludes
